newsitem.title: USA: Deluxe Corp buys FUSION Marketing.
newsitem.headline: Deluxe Corp buys FUSION Marketing.

text.p: Deluxe Corp said Monday it acquired FUSION Marketing Group of Memphis, Tenn., which provides broad-based customized database marketing services targeted to U.S. financial institutions.
Terms of the acquisition were not disclosed.
Deluxe said FUSION will become part of its Deluxe Direct Response business unit.
Deluxe Direct Response has expanded its services to its financial client base since its formation as a new Deluxe business unit late last year, the company said.

"The missions of Deluxe Direct Response and FUSION are virtually the same -- use knowledge-based solutions to help clients make their customer base more profitable," J.A. "Gus" Blanchard, chairman Deluxe Corp, said in a statement. "The addition of FUSION adds to Deluxe's value chain of providing strategic direct response marketing and program management to customers."

Under the acquisition agreement, FUSION will operate under the name FUSION Marketing, a Service of Deluxe. Along with Deluxe's resources, FUSION will continue its relationships with outside vendors to maintain access to a broad range of direct marketing solutions for its clients, Deluxe said.
FUSION employees also will continue as providers of customized direct response consulting.

Deluxe provides products and services to financial institutions and their customers through its four business units: Deluxe Direct Response, Deluxe Payment Protection Systems, Deluxe Electronic Payment Systems and Deluxe Paper Payment Systems.
